name: ridgetop-monorepo
description: Ridgetop monorepo: standalone ridgetop framework package and independent example games

scripts.build:examples: tsc -p examples/beacon-run/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/signal-drift/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/lighthouse/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/crownshard/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/starter/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/ridgetop/tsconfig.build.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{fs.copyFileSync('packages/ridgetop/framework/testing-overlay.css','packages/ridgetop/dist/framework/testing-overlay.css');fs.chmodSync('packages/ridgetop/dist/tools/cli.js',0o755)})" && tsc -p examples/beacon-run/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/signal-drift/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/lighthouse/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/crownshard/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p examples/starter/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/build-workshop.ts && node tools/build-player.ts && node tools/build-models.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ridgetop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/beacon-run/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/signal-drift/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/lighthouse/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/crownshard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/starter/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
